Name: Fairy Rat Trinket Replacement
Author: gutsykrow
Description:
Changes the sprite for the default fairy trinket into the fairy rat from Pizza Tower.
[b]+[/b] Option to select between Fairy Rat and [b]Evil Rat[/b] through config file/GMCM (For those who prefer to live on the [i]spicier[/i] side.)

I am neither a capable pixel artist no programmer, I just wanted more rats and decided to share.
(Should function properly with Stardew Valley version 1.6+)

[b]Installation:
[/b]Unzip the downloaded file and place its contents into the Stardew/Mods folder.

[b]Requires:
[/b]SMAPI and Content Patcher

Downloads.Description: Replaces the sprite for the default fairy trinket with the fairy rat from Pizza Tower.
